query: SELECT column_name, COUNT(*) FROM dim_column_metadata WHERE column_name IN ('created_by','updated_by','approved_by','created_at','updated_at','approved_at','status','priority','reason_code','row_version','data_quality_score','is_deleted','remarks','document_no','business_date','posting_date','event_time') GROUP BY 1
result: created_at/updated_at/approved_at/status/data_quality_score/is_deleted/remarks present on 92 tables; created_by/updated_by on 92; approved_by on 67; business_date/posting_date/event_time on 67; priority on 68; reason_code on 69; row_version on 67; document_no on 67. Confirms one uniform audit/governance envelope reused across the middle-tier fact tables.

query: SELECT DISTINCT created_by FROM fact_lead ORDER BY 1; SELECT DISTINCT approved_by FROM fact_kpi_snapshot ORDER BY 1; SELECT emp_id,emp_name FROM dim_employee LIMIT 3;
result: created_by/updated_by/approved_by values are U0001..U0012 (text user codes). dim_employee.emp_id is INTEGER (1..122) and emp_name is '合成员工0086'-style. No U-code appears in dim_employee. So audit '人' columns are a separate system-user namespace, not dim_employee.
validation_method: value-domain sampling on two tables plus dim_employee cross-check

query: SELECT column_name, COUNT(*) FROM dim_column_metadata WHERE column_name IN ('base_quantity','tax_amount','local_amount','amount','quantity','unit_price','exchange_rate','cost_amount','budget_amount','planned_quantity','actual_quantity','qualified_quantity','rejected_quantity','rate_value','score_value','duration_minutes','priority','currency_code') GROUP BY 1
result: base_quantity 38, tax_amount 41, local_amount 40, amount 48, quantity 47, unit_price 46, exchange_rate 40, cost_amount 40, budget_amount 22, planned_quantity 42, actual_quantity 41, qualified_quantity 38, rejected_quantity 38, rate_value 25, score_value 25, duration_minutes 19, priority 68, currency_code 40. The same measure columns are reused verbatim across dozens of fact tables, so measure vocabulary is cross-table.

row_version ranges 1..3 over 168 fact_lead rows. The workload sums/averages this column ('按销售线索的行版本合计排序','生产工时报工的行版本平均值','质量问题行版本合计'), so it functions as an aggregatable metric, not only as a concurrency token.

query: SELECT remarks,COUNT(*) FROM fact_labor_booking GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6; SELECT remarks,COUNT(*) FROM fact_customer_contact GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6; SELECT remarks,COUNT(*) FROM fact_skill_assessment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6;
result: remarks draws from a small closed vocabulary: '' (dominant), 已电话确认, 客户指定批次, 加急, 跨月处理, 补录. Same vocabulary on fact_labor_booking (156/154/152/150/168 among 19487 rows), fact_customer_contact (14/9/8/7/6 among 879), fact_skill_assessment (2/2/1/1).

fact_quotation: won 357 / lost 113 / draft 6. fact_tax_invoice_line: CLOSED 4768 / APPROVED 311. fact_transfer_order: CLOSED 819 / APPROVED 48. fact_sales_order: delivered 4576 / undelivered 152 / returned 3. fact_opportunity: won 36 / open 22 / lost 20 / stalled 6. fact_employee_assignment: APPROVED 121 / CLOSED 1. fact_ap: closed 879 / open 122. fact_asn_line: CLOSED 947 / APPROVED 70. dim_employee: active 121 / inactive 1. dim_customer: active 22 / lost 2 / dormant 1. Status domains differ by business family.
validation_method: enumeration of status value domains across 10 tables

query: SELECT column_name, COUNT(*) FROM dim_column_metadata WHERE column_name LIKE '%date%' OR column_name IN ('event_time','created_at','updated_at','approved_at','start_time','end_time','deadline') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
result: Envelope dates business_date/posting_date/event_time on 67 tables; created_at/updated_at/approved_at on 92; due_date 15; expiry_date 11; closed_date 10; manufacture_date 8; requested_date/promised_date/received_date 4 each; requested_delivery_date/promised_delivery_date 3 each; action_due_date 3; also single-table dates (audit_date, quotation_date, payment_date, return_date, receipt_date, incident_date, sample_date, output_date, close_date, create_date, deadline, pr_date, feedback_date, valid_until).

dim_calendar spans 2025-01-01..2026-07-01 with 547 rows, one row per day. Fact-table business_date ranges fall inside it (e.g. fact_lead 2025-01-01..2026-06-19), so date-to-calendar joins are lossless.
validation_method: range comparison between dim_calendar and fact_lead

query: SELECT DISTINCT holiday_name FROM dim_calendar WHERE holiday_name<>''; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_calendar WHERE holiday_name IS NOT NULL AND holiday_name<>'';
result: 40 non-empty rows with holiday_name in {元旦,春节,清明节,劳动节,端午节,中秋节,国庆节,法定节假日}. '国庆节' is present (国定节假日 window), supporting '国庆节当天' and '对应的节假日名称' style questions.

line_id/line_name (PP挤出1线..)/workshop_id/product_type/capacity_tph/status. workshop_id is the line-to-workshop link used by '车间->生产工单' two-hop questions.

CNY/USD/EUR/JPY with exchange_rate (7.12/7.78/0.048) and decimal digits. Fact tables carry currency_code as a text column matching these codes.

query: SELECT * FROM dim_hazard; SELECT hazard_type,COUNT(*) FROM fact_hazard_observation GROUP BY 1;

12 rows: QUALITY/DELIVERY/COST/EQUIPMENT/SAFETY/ENVIRONMENT/CUSTOMER/SUPPLIER/PROCESS/MATERIAL/SYSTEM/OTHER, each with name, short_name and abbreviation (e.g. QUALITY -> 质量原因 / QUA). usage_scope is 全业务.

query: for every table having a reason_code column: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT reason_code) ...
result: Only 3 tables have a non-constant reason_code: dim_downtime_reason (8), fact_downtime (8 integer ids), fact_equipment_event (6). All other tables (including fact_transfer_order and fact_transfer_order_line, both pinned to 'OTHER') have a single constant value despite the column name. So a question phrased as '原因' is not reliably grounded on the generic reason_code column.
validation_method: distinct-count scan of reason_code over all 200 tables

'滤网更换' present.
